---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for mcp-ctl
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do**

A sentence about the workflow, not the implementation. Name the MCP server if the
request is about one in particular.

**What you have to do instead today**

The workaround, if there is one.

**What you would like mcp-ctl to do**

If the idea changes the profile file, say whether it can be additive; a breaking
key is a minor version, not a patch.
